title: Patch: the Starship's moment: pieces bolt on as it fuses, and a countdown, ignition and lift-off as it launches
notes: R2801000: the Dormant Starship's face bolts on a hull plate for each piece fused into it (apps/web/src/cards/StarshipHull.tsx); the fuse and launch animations are the effects layer's. How cards look only: nothing plays differently.

player.title: The Starship's moment
changes: The Dormant Starship shows a hull plate for each piece fused into it, and each piece flies over and bolts on as it fuses.
Launching the Starship plays a 3-2-1 countdown, ignition and lift-off, bigger the more pieces it holds; tap to skip it.
